_comment: Reviewed C7 reconstruction policy. The generator combines these closed durability-class decisions with schema IR and reviewed aggregate parent links; unknown classes, incomplete relationships, and unsafe phase dependencies fail closed.

recreated_state.cold_tier_service_identity: Register target-local platform service bindings through trusted operator workflows; never restore privileged identities from a source cell.
recreated_state.derived_rebuildable: Recompute from restored canonical rows after durable restoration completes.
recreated_state.organization_reconstruction_batch_receip: Create target-local idempotency receipts while applying the current reconstruction run; never restore receipts from a source cell.
recreated_state.organization_reconstruction_fence: Acquire a fresh target-local writer fence for the reconstruction run; never restore a stale source-cell fence.

excluded_state.platform_control: Platform-global identity, credential, migration, and service-control rows are not organization state.
